items: The regional director reviewed every complaint ____ before approving the revised response procedure.
The emphatic pronoun 'herself' stresses that the director personally reviewed every complaint.
New employees are expected to familiarize ____ with the expense policy during orientation.
The verb pattern 'familiarize themselves with' requires the reflexive pronoun because the employees act on themselves.
The vendor introduced ____ as a specialist in warehouse automation.
The vendor is both the subject and the person being introduced, so the reflexive pronoun 'himself' is required.
We completed the inventory count ____ rather than bringing in temporary staff.
'Ourselves' emphasizes that the speakers personally completed the inventory count.
The automatic gate resets ____ after an authorized vehicle passes through.
The gate is both the subject and the thing being reset, so 'itself' is required.
Ms. Rivera found ____ leading two projects after the department was reorganized.
In the pattern 'find oneself doing something', the subject and object refer to the same person, so 'herself' is required.
The finance team prepared the supporting schedules ____ before sending them to the auditors.
'Themselves' emphasizes that the finance team members personally prepared the schedules.
Please make ____ comfortable in the waiting area while the interviewer finishes the previous meeting.
The fixed expression 'make yourself comfortable' requires the reflexive pronoun 'yourself'.
The two negotiators kept the details of the preliminary agreement to ____ until both companies approved it.
The expression 'keep something to themselves' requires the reflexive pronoun because the negotiators retain the information within their own group.
I prepared the demonstration ____ so that I could answer technical questions about every step.
'Myself' emphasizes that the speaker personally prepared the demonstration.
The company ____ will cover the cost of replacing the defective units.
The emphatic pronoun 'itself' follows 'the company' to stress that the company, rather than another party, will cover the cost.
After the workshop, participants evaluated ____ using the checklist provided by the instructor.
The participants are both the people evaluating and the people evaluated, so 'themselves' is required.
Mr. Okada taught ____ how to use the new reporting software by following the online tutorials.
The subject learned without another teacher, so the reflexive pronoun 'himself' is required after 'taught'.
You can update the contact information ____ through the customer portal.
'Yourself' emphasizes that the customer can personally update the information without assistance.
The department head signed the revised policy ____ before asking supervisors to distribute it.
'Herself' emphasizes that the department head personally signed the policy.
The interns organized ____ into small groups for the afternoon exercise.
The interns perform the action on their own group, so the reflexive pronoun 'themselves' is required.
Our project team set ____ a deadline of Friday for completing the first prototype.
The team gives its own members a deadline, so the reflexive pronoun 'ourselves' is required.
The consultant ____ presented the findings instead of sending a junior analyst.
The emphatic pronoun 'himself' stresses that the consultant personally presented the findings.
The device protects ____ from overheating by shutting down when the internal temperature rises too high.
The device is both the subject doing the protecting and the object being protected, so 'itself' is required.
Before contacting support, users should ask ____ whether the problem occurs on more than one browser.
The users direct the question to themselves, so the reflexive pronoun 'themselves' is required.
The owner designed the café's new menu ____ after studying customer feedback.
'Herself' emphasizes that the owner personally designed the menu.
After receiving the access code, I was able to complete the account setup by ____.
The expression 'by myself' means without assistance and requires the reflexive pronoun 'myself'.
The board members discussed the confidential proposal among ____ before inviting the legal team into the room.
When the members of a group interact within that same group after 'among', the reflexive pronoun 'themselves' is required here.
Ms. Grant reminded ____ to bring the signed purchase agreement to the closing meeting.
Ms. Grant is both the person reminding and the person being reminded, so 'herself' is required.
The research group developed the forecasting model ____ instead of purchasing a commercial package.
'Themselves' emphasizes that the group members personally developed the model.
